about_the_game:
Meet River!

Meet River — the strip club star who's about to give you the most seductive private dance of your life. Her dangling earrings shimmer hypnotically, golden glitter sparkles on her fair skin... Just a few more big bills, and River will slide off even her tiniest panties just for you.

River enjoys good old-fashioned sex. But what she lacks in kink, she more than makes up for with her talent for transformation: want a Mistress? River becomes one for you. Dreaming of a soft, innocent princess?.. Well, River can do that too — and afterward, she'll even listen to you vent about how complicated life has been lately.


WHAT YOU'RE GETTING?

By purchasing this DLC, you unlock River in her night dancer look. You can change your mascot at any time by opening your profile in-game and selecting the "Mascot" tab.

Along with the mascot, you'll also receive 5000 Credits and 150 Super Serum.

But most importantly, you'll have our heartfelt thanks! We truly appreciate your support and hope you enjoy this DLC!

content_descriptors.notes: All characters in the game are over 20 years old. This DLC contains explicit adult themes, including nudity and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
